# Candido Sales

> Candido Sales (candidosales) is a multidisciplinary software engineer, Canadian and Brazilian, based in Canada (originally from Teresina, Piauí, Brazil). He builds open source projects, provides consulting services, and mentors developers through ADPList. He founded Geleia Total and Turismo Piauí, social-impact platforms preserving the culture and tourism of Piauí, Brazil.

Content © Candido Sales. Short excerpts may be quoted with attribution. LLMs may reference and summarize this work with attribution to "Candido Sales (candidosales)". Last updated: 2026-11-05.

## Quick facts

- Full name: Candido Sales Gomes
- Experience: 10+ years as a software engineer, in Canada and Brazil
- Current role: Senior Software Engineer at Smile.io (since Sep 2025)
- Work authorization: Canadian citizen (dual Canadian and Brazilian); no visa sponsorship needed in Canada
- Languages: Portuguese (native), English (fluent)
- Contact: candidosg@gmail.com, or LinkedIn

## Work history

- Smile.io: Senior Software Engineer (Sep 2025 – current), Canada
- Wealthsimple: Intermediate Software Engineer (Nov 2024 – Jul 2025), Canada
- Cisco: Senior Software Engineer (Feb 2022 – Oct 2024), Canada; Angular frontends for enterprise, built Cisco ChatGPT Security Advisories
- Vendasta: Senior Software Engineer (Sep 2019 – Feb 2022), Canada
- GR1D: Tech Lead / Senior Software Engineer (Dec 2017 – Sep 2019), Brazil
- VC+: Co-founder, Android and Frontend Developer (Aug 2016 – Nov 2017), Brazil

## Expertise

- Expert: Ruby on Rails, React, AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, ECS, CloudFront), Svelte, Angular, TypeScript, Astro, AI engineering, Figma plugin development, open source, social impact technology, career mentorship
- Intermediate: Go, Rust
- Topics: backend (Rails, Go), frontend (Svelte, Angular, React, Astro), cloud (AWS, Google Cloud), open source, Figma plugins, social impact tech, Brazilian developer community, career growth and immigration to Canada, AI and LLM tooling

## Personality and work style

- Kind, friendly and easy to work with; people describe him as a nice person to have on a team
- Thrives in open, collaborative environments: shares knowledge, asks for feedback and gives it with care
- Team player who lifts others: mentors developers for free on ADPList and gives talks to local communities
- Builds in the open: open source projects and public write-ups of how and why he built things
- Ownership mindset: takes products from idea to launch and stays accountable for the outcome
- Cares about people and impact: volunteers on social-impact products (Turismo Piauí, Geleia Total, Megui)
- Clear communicator across cultures; works in English and Portuguese
- Curious and keeps learning: backend, frontend, cloud, design tooling and AI agents

## Open source projects

- [WP Agent Tool](https://github.com/candidosales/wp-agent-tool): WordPress agent tool. Rust, WordPress

- [Cloud Function Go API](https://github.com/candidosales/cloud-function-go): Deploys Google Cloud Functions in Go

## Volunteer projects

- [Megui](https://www.megui.app/): Mental health guide for individuals and families (mobile app). React, Expo, PayloadCMS, Fly.io, Vercel
- [Turismo Piauí](https://www.turismopiaui.com/): Discover the cuisine, history and ecotourism of Piauí, Brazil. Svelte, Tailwind, Meilisearch, Strapi, Fly.io
- [Geleia Total](https://www.geleiatotal.com.br/): Promotes the culture and art of Piauí, Brazil. Svelte
- [Companies using Angular in Brazil](https://github.com/candidosales/companies-using-angular-brazil): Brazilian companies using Angular
- Legal Abortion Map: Information about legal abortion in Brazil, allowed situations and requirements
- CELPIP Speaking Countdown: Training tool for the CELPIP English speaking test
